role_inputs_recipe.resource_selection: Every eligible .py resource beneath each declared root; lexical address order.
role_inputs_recipe.memberships: Production immediate membership derivation for each module analysis.
role_inputs_recipe.mirrors: Production mirrored-path derivation over the exact frozen frame.
role_inputs_recipe.configuration_resolution: Production declarations and selectors, module universe from both root analyses, explicit working_directory='.' and pytest_root='.'.
role_inputs_recipe.retention: Retain native RI analyses and the production-derived role view itself. No role assignments are inspected to optimize treatment.

routing.matching: ANY selected role with positive evidence; empty preference is escape-only.
routing.order: Preferred before escape; original native order within each; one-based routed presentation position; native rank retained.

surfaces: A: global full-task native BM25 rank
measurements.required_reach: For every adjudicated REQUIRED information unit and unique resource: global rank, own rank, own routed position, tier and reach within bound; absence of positive lexical match is distinct from deep rank.
measurements.alternatives: For each acceptable conjunctive witness alternative compute all three completion depths/positions as maximum member position, only if every member is reachable. An incomplete alternative has no finite completion. Any one complete alternative suffices; preserve raw required-unit judgments separately.
measurements.obligations: Report each alternative separately and the best finite acceptable completion on each surface for each applicable mandatory obligation. Multiple query lanes remain independent; if later added only through a distinct treatment, no merged ranking is inferred.
whole_case: Obligation-wise maximum of best native acceptable-alternative completion depths
Obligation-wise maximum of best routed acceptable-alternative completion positions
Complete mandatory acquisition coverage ratios separately for global/native-own/routed-own
measurements.review_surface: For each obligation count native prefix through best finite own completion and routed prefix through best finite routed completion. Report summed occurrences and unique resource unions separately. If an obligation lacks finite completion, report incomplete review surface rather than silently omit it or invent a finite whole-case surface.
measurements.tiers: Per lane preferred/escape totals; REQUIRED, HELPFUL_ONLY and UNNECESSARY unit/resource counts per tier (obligation-relative, separate units and resources). Report unresolved judgments separately. REQUIRED in ESCAPE is a routing limitation, not candidate loss.
measurements.safety: Identify globally reachable witnesses poorly routed, deep escape witnesses, routed worse than own native, own native worse than global, empty-preference unchanged lanes. Poorly/deep are descriptive exact position comparisons, not an invented numeric threshold.
measurements.structural: Lane/result counts, summed native occurrences, all-lane unique union, duplicates, global/obligation overlap, zero-result lanes; unique required resources shared across obligations; own/cross/global reach; rank/position improvement, worsening and equality counts.
measurements.helpful: Separate helpful-only rank/position/tier diagnostics; never include helpful evidence in mandatory witness completion.
measurements.lexical_diagnosis: After primary metrics only, native content/filename contributions may explain conspicuous differences; no raw score comparison across lanes or causal assertion.
measurements.interpretation: No numeric pass/fail superiority threshold. Observations separate from architectural interpretation; one case cannot establish general superiority.
